title: Transcript Sync Report
description: 07_transcript_sync output (scripts/fetch_videos.py). Deterministic bookkeeping — which candidate video_ids already had a cached transcript, which were freshly fetched, which failed. No generator judgment happens in this stage.

outcome.description: failed_no_captions: video genuinely has no caption track available, not a fetch problem. failed_fetch_error: a real fetch failure (rate limit, network) — retry-worthy, distinct from no_captions.
